overview.text: Beth K. Whittenbury is a member and secretary of the Palos Verdes Library District Board of Trustees, serving since October 2025. She is an educator, author, consultant, and mediator. She lists her priorities as keeping libraries open and welcoming, ensuring equal access to media, providing inclusive programming, and spending property-tax funding responsibly.
